result.title: DLER: Dual-Logit Experience Replay for Online Continual Learning
result.summary: Online continual learning aims to continuously train neural networks on a non-stationary data stream in a single pass. Rehearsal-based methods alleviate catastrophic forgetting by replaying stored samples, but the imbalance between current and previous data often leads to predictions biased toward current classes. Many approaches have been proposed to overcome the forgetting problem by correcting the bias; however, they still need to be improved in an online fashion. By decomposing the dot-product logits into an angle factor and a norm factor, our analysis reveals that the angle factor efficiently captures novel knowledge but is particularly susceptible to prediction bias, whereas the norm factor helps preserve historical knowledge. Based on these observations, we propose Dual-Logit Experience Replay (DLER), which exploits dual-logits for both model optimization and memory management. Specifically, DLER learns current samples using cosine logits and incorporates additional dot-product logits when replaying previous samples to mitigate prediction bias. To strengthen dual-logit learning under limited replay memory, an auxiliary supervised contrastive objective promotes angular compactness within each class, extending corrections learned from limited replay samples to other samples of the same class. Meanwhile, we introduce a memory update strategy that preferentially retains samples for which dot-product prediction assigns a higher probability to the correct class than cosine prediction, aligning sample selection with dual-logit training. Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of DLER, particularly under limited memory budgets.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对在线持续学习中新旧数据不平衡导致的预测偏置，将点积 logit 分解为角度与范数两项，提出 DLER：用余弦 logit 学习当前样本、回放旧样本时叠加点积 logit，并辅以类内角度紧凑的对比目标与优先保留判别差异样本的记忆更新策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 VLM 推理主线距离较远，但其「按新旧预测差异挑选回放样本」的记忆管理与角度/范数分离的表示几何，或可作为 latent 轨迹缓存筛选与内部状态中内容—幅值分离的借鉴线索，需核查其在线设定下是否稳定。
